name: @argszero/cordis-plugin-empty-response-guard
description: Guards for silent successful turns in dsh: observes the llm/stream waterfall and reclassifies (1) a reasoning-only completion (a stop with no text and no tool call) as EMPTY_RESPONSE and (2) a stop whose usage accounts for zero tokens on a route that has reported usage as a retryable TRANSPORT error, so the harness reports the failure and its retry policy can act instead of silently ending the turn. Reconciled with the in-tree guard family and AssistantStream's chunkHasVisibleText predicate. Compatible with every prerelease line from 0.1.3-alpha.2 onward (0.1.3/0.1.5/0.1.6).
